-- True when the path, once "." and ".." segments are resolved, stays
-- inside its root and names something. Absolute paths, paths that climb
-- above the root, and the empty path are all rejected.
stays_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("..") == False
  ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex stays_inside("") == False
  var depth = 0
  var first = True
  for seg in path.split("/")
    if first
      first = False
      -- an empty first segment means a leading "/" or an empty path
      if seg == ""
        return False
    if seg == "" or seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  depth > 0

-- Text of the file at `path` inside the directory `notes`, or "" when the
-- path leaves `notes`, or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post stays_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
  if not stays_inside(path)
    return ""
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    result = fs.read(path) else ""
  result
